messages:
Sophia: quick ping — opened PR to change how we store service-account secrets and add an audit enrichment field. this touches KMS envelope wrapping + audit schema. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4890
Ben: thanks — will take a look today, can you paste the minimal config diff?
Sophia: sure, gist of the change:
```
secrets_backend: kms
use_envelope: true
audit.enrich: [service, actor_email]
```
Ana: heads-up: needs at least one security-owner approval and one infra approval for the KMS key policy tweak. is rollout planned as migration or seamless? :eyes:
Sophia: seamless migration. new writes use envelope; reads fallback to old path until we backfill. migration plan in PR description.
Ryan: quick question about audit field name — `actor_email` ok for PII? we should hash it or use a stable id. cc @Ana
Ana: prefer hashed_actor_id. less risky for logs forwarded to third parties. add a note in PR about hashing and retention.
Sophia: got it, will update. also added a small unit test for key wrapping behavior.
Ben: reviewing now. small nit: the KMS permission grant uses `projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*` broad pattern — can we scope it to the service account instead?
Sophia: yes, will narrow.
CI Bot: PR #4890 — build: passed, lint: passed, tests: 182/183 (1 flaky test skipped) :white_check_mark:
Ben: left a couple inline comments on the key policy and the migration script timing. nothing blocking.
Ana: I'm fine with approval once Sophia replaces actor_email with hashed_actor_id and documents retention policy.
Sophia: updating now, will push a follow-up commit in ~15m. anyone else who wants eyes? tagging @Ryan for infra timing.
Ryan: I can give infra approval after the policy scoping change and a short rollout note (how we will revert if something breaks).
Sophia: adding revert steps and a rollback playbook excerpt. also adding a log sample for the audit enrichment.
Ben: approved. :+1:
Ana: approved (security). :lock:
Sophia: thanks all — merging after CI finishes and we'll kick off migration job tomorrow morning (UTC). tagging in runbook channel once migration starts. :rocket:
Deploy Bot: merge: PR #4890 merged to main by Sophia at 1814568240.
CI Bot: post-merge CI: all checks green.
Sophia: update — migration job scheduled for 2026-06-12 03:00 UTC. will post results here.
Ryan: noted, will monitor infra metrics.
Sophia: closing the ping, thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:
